CertificateVersion.description: The version of the certificate used for authentication and encryption.
CertificateVersion.longDescription: This property indicates the version of the certificate, which is vital for ensuring compatibility with authentication and encryption protocols. The certificate version helps in managing updates or changes in the security standards, ensuring that the communication remains secure and compliant with the latest protocols.

PublicKey.description: The public key used for certificate-based authentication and encryption.
